WITH race_avg_wins AS (
  SELECT 
    r.raceId,
    r.circuitId,
    c.country,
    AVG(ds.wins) as avg_wins_in_race
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  JOIN driverStandings ds ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
  GROUP BY r.raceId, r.circuitId, c.country
),
country_avg_wins AS (
  SELECT 
    country,
    AVG(avg_wins_in_race) as avg_wins
  FROM race_avg_wins
  GROUP BY country
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as overall_avg
  FROM country_avg_wins
),
above_overall AS (
  SELECT 
    c.country,
    c.avg_wins,
    c.avg_wins - o.overall_avg as above_overall
  FROM country_avg_wins c
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
  WHERE c.avg_wins > o.overall_avg
),
group_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as group_avg
  FROM above_overall
)
SELECT 
  a.country,
  a.avg_wins,
  a.above_overall,
  a.avg_wins - g.group_avg as above_group
FROM above_overall a
CROSS JOIN group_avg g
WHERE a.avg_wins > g.group_avg
ORDER BY a.avg_wins DESC;
